- Game Hub: the Details, All games and Library buttons work: the code behind them sat outside the shelf's own scope and stopped with an error (found by running the page in a browser with a fake phone); the Select games list works too.
- Windows 11 clock and quick-settings panel: as tall as what it holds (the blurred picture behind it made it as tall as the screen).
- Gallery: the list of pictures is kept on disk, so it shows at once even right after the phone restarts; no file check per picture while reading (it was slow on a big library); the Albums tab has a folder icon (it looked like Photos).
- Gallery viewer: a pinch stops page turning at once (it was taken for a swipe and showed the black edge of the next page when the fingers lifted); the last three pictures stay in memory, so a page made again shows at once.
- Windows desktops: a long press on the taskbar opens its own menu (Task Manager, Automatically hide the taskbar, Taskbar settings); hidden, a tap or a swipe on the screen edge shows it for a few seconds.
